timing.note: elapsedMs includes earlier preflight attempts and interruptions; scenarioWallMs starts with the first posted scenario message. Neither is exclusive model execution time.

finalMemory.note: Entry counts are storage coverage, not a count of independently proven correct facts; historical failures remain in the run.

generationAccounting.unit: Observed llm/stream lifecycles, including native short-circuit acknowledgements; not a count of independently verified provider HTTP requests. completedCalls is a legacy field for ended lifecycles, including failed or truncated ones; successfulCalls excludes these.

limitations: One physical host; not a physical multi-machine test.
Existing native history remains available after compaction; correct recall is not proof that vector retrieval alone produced the answer.
The actual natural run used multiple explicitly recorded repair generations; earlier failures are not overwritten.
Expense, registration and code outcomes do not validate all prose facts in generated handoffs.
